sla_statement: Public calibnet RPC chain-head lag: wall-clock expected epoch minus reported Height, measured daily

FEVM/Eth RPC surface keeps pace: wall-clock expected epoch minus decoded eth_blockNumber <= 4 epochs, measured daily — the eth_* API is what FEVM dApps depend on, runs ~1 epoch below the native head by construction (so 4 = native 3 + 1), and can stall independently of the native API
Public mainnet RPC serves a fresh chain head: wall-clock expected epoch minus reported Height <= 5 epochs (150s), measured daily — a stale head means the endpoint's backing node has stopped syncing
Blockscout Calibration testnet explorer indexing lag: age of the newest indexed block, measured daily — upgrade rehearsal needs a working explorer to analyse
Blockscout Filecoin mainnet explorer indexing lag: age of the newest indexed block, measured daily — a stale explorer is not an observability surface
Explorer pace against the chain: the largest gap between consecutive indexed tipsets, measured daily
Public calibnet RPC chain-head lag: wall-clock expected epoch minus reported Height, measured daily — calibnet is the upgrade-rehearsal target developers stage against
FEVM/Eth RPC chain-head lag: wall-clock expected epoch minus decoded eth_blockNumber, measured daily — the eth_* API is what FEVM dApps depend on and can stall independently of the native API
Public mainnet RPC chain-head lag: wall-clock expected epoch minus reported Height, measured daily — a stale head means the endpoint's backing node has stopped syncing
Chain.Love's own uptime monitor for the funded endpoint reports availability over the trailing window, measured daily — the operator-reported view of the service the grant funds
Median public RPC response latency from Chain.Love's own metrics feed, measured daily — a fresh chain head says the node is syncing, but not that the endpoint is usable
ChainSafe mainnet bootstrap host resolvability: DNS RCODE for bootstrap-mainnet-0.chainsafe-fil.io, measured daily — a fresh node that cannot resolve its seed peers 'starts and just sits there'
ChainSafe's calibnet faucet wallet t1lo4ajjyeygqn3lkrw6izwz6aft5chshngs6gjxa keeps dispensing: days since its last on-chain message <= 7, measured daily
ChainSafe's calibnet rehearsal miner t0181521 keeps >= 250 TB quality-adjusted power on-chain (the team's own Karma target), measured weekly
Calibnet snapshot freshness: age of the newest snapshot in the archive listing, measured daily
Forest ships a release at least every 45 days on average (active-maintenance signal), measured monthly
Fresh mainnet DIFF snapshots keep publishing: newest diff snapshot in the archive listing is <= 172800s (48h) old, measured daily
Fresh mainnet LITE snapshots keep publishing: newest lite snapshot in the archive listing is <= 2592000s (30 days) old, measured daily
Mainnet snapshot freshness: age of the newest snapshot in the archive listing, measured daily
Open issue count on filecoin-project/filecoin-docs, measured weekly — the backlog the funded documentation work is drawing down
Docs repo activity: age of the most recent commit on filecoin-project/filecoin-docs, measured weekly
Cuzk SP improvements ported into Lotus Miner: count of cuzk PRs merged into filecoin-project/lotus during the grant term (2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31) >= 1, measured monthly
Dataset freshness: age of the most recent successful daily Pipeline run, measured daily
The public Filecoin status page was updated <= 45 days ago, measured weekly — a live status/monitoring surface is the public face of incident response
Committee attests vendor/access governance, runbooks and workspace stewardship were performed, measured monthly (UNMEASURABLE BY MACHINE; fixture placeholder)
Groth16 parameter gateway (proofs.filecoin.io) availability >= 0.99, measured monthly — nodes and SPs cannot verify or generate proofs without these files (AWAITING REAL SOURCE; fixture placeholder)
A tagged builtin-actors release <= 90 days old, measured monthly
PDP on mainnet: count of active proof sets, measured daily
Curio release cadence: average days between releases (a sealing-pipeline maintenance signal), measured monthly
Win-count health: network average blocks per tipset, of 5 expected, measured daily — a network-wide reading rather than a Curio-specific one
builtin-actors (home of the EVM + EAM actors) ships a release at least every 60 days on average, measured monthly
Lotus ships a stable (non-RC) release at least every 60 days on average (consensus-client maintenance signal), measured monthly
Mainnet keeps its ~30s epoch cadence: average tipset interval <= 45s, measured daily
PDP provider base holds: total registered PDP providers >= 3 (Curio Core's Karma target names >= 3 mainnet providers), measured weekly
Goldsky-hosted Filecoin FEVM subgraph indexing-error flag (hasIndexingErrors), measured daily
Goldsky-hosted Filecoin FEVM subgraph indexing lag: wall clock minus indexed block timestamp, measured daily — stale chain ETL breaks every downstream consumer at once
go-libp2p ships a release every 60 days on average (active-maintenance signal), measured monthly — the transport/GossipSub/DHT stack must track upstream fixes
Mainnet advances on the ~30s epoch cadence: avg seconds per epoch <= 45, measured daily — blocks only arrive on cadence if GossipSub propagation and peer discovery work
Lily has a commit <= 90 days old, measured monthly — the chain ETL/indexer must track network upgrades or the open datasets it feeds go stale
IPNI providers error-free: >= 90% of providers report no LastError, measured daily
Ad-chain ingestion liveness: providers showing a LastAdvertisementTime within the past 24h, measured daily
Breadth of the IPNI provider set: providers listed on cid.contact, measured daily
The IPNI indexer reports itself ready on its own health endpoint (1 when status is 'ready', else 0), measured daily — the readiness signal the committee asked for and cid.contact now serves as JSON
Plumbline's calibnet SP t0143103 stays decentralization-friendly: its share of calibnet quality-adjusted power < 1/3 (the team's own Karma target), measured weekly
bellperson (Groth16 prover) has a commit <= 180 days old, measured monthly — the crypto primitives under PoRep/PoSt must remain maintained
rust-fil-proofs has a commit <= 120 days old, measured monthly — the proving library must stay staffed; a regression here halts proving network-wide
An independent drand HTTP relay (Cloudflare) stays in sync: expected - current <= 2 rounds, measured daily — randomness must be reachable even if the primary relay fails
Randamu relay mirror serves fresh quicknet rounds: wall-clock expected round minus served round <= 20 rounds (60s), measured daily
drand's own status-page incident indicator, measured daily — the operator-reported health of the HTTP relay network Filecoin SPs consume randomness from
drand ships a software-stack release at least every 45 days on average (active-maintenance signal), measured monthly
drand beacon relay not lagging: expected - current <= 1 round, measured daily
USDFC–axlUSDC pool depth: GeckoTerminal reserve_in_usd, measured weekly. Reported for context — the agreement places liquidity provision outside this grant's scope
USDFC–axlUSDC pool trading flow: GeckoTerminal 24h volume_usd, measured daily. Reported for context — the team commits to publishing this figure, not to reaching a level
USDFC peg deviation: USDFC–axlUSDC pool price minus 1.00 USD, signed, read at measurement time and measured daily. Positive is a premium over peg, negative a discount
USDFC redemption fee: TroveManager getRedemptionRate(), measured daily. Reported for context — a higher rate is normal protocol behaviour under redemption pressure, not a fault
Damocles has a commit <= 120 days old, measured monthly — the Venus distributed sealing cluster must remain maintained for SP-side client diversity
sophon-miner has a commit <= 120 days old, measured monthly — the Venus pooled block-production path must keep pace with network upgrades or Venus SPs lose their independent block-winning route
Rosetta stack currency: age of the latest rosetta-filecoin-proxy release, measured weekly
Zondax archival RPC depth: the height returned by ChainGetTipSetByHeight(100000), Sep 2020, measured weekly — pruned nodes cannot answer this
